summary: Pass. The dark-map validation artifacts resolve the prior residual scene-off brightness/flicker failure for the four orbit render conditions. All four settings contain rgb.mp4, depth_meters_viridis.mp4, metadata.json, and 240-frame RGB/depth frame sets. scene_off_flashlight_off is black throughout, scene_off_flashlight_on shows only localized flashlight-lit geometry on a black background, scene-on settings remain lit, and direct frame luma checks show no progressive exposure accumulation.
work_completed: Inspected examples/flashlight/orbit_collection_output_validation_dark_map for all four settings and confirmed each has rgb.mp4, depth_meters_viridis.mp4, metadata.json, and complete frame outputs.
Compared against prior Inspector and Scout result packets documenting the earlier bright scene-off residual failure.
Computed independent RGB luma series from saved PNG frames for all four settings and checked frame-to-frame/chunk behavior for exposure accumulation.
Compared depth_meters_npy frames across settings and confirmed depth geometry is stable across lighting conditions.
Performed visual inspection using RGB contact sheets and flashlight-delta contact sheets generated outside the repository in /tmp.

findings.message: Artifact completeness passes. examples/flashlight/orbit_collection_output_validation_dark_map contains scene_off_flashlight_off, scene_off_flashlight_on, scene_on_flashlight_off, and scene_on_flashlight_on, and each setting has rgb.mp4, depth_meters_viridis.mp4, metadata.json, plus 720 frame files under frames/ (240 RGB PNG, 240 depth_meters_npy, 240 depth_meters_viridis PNG). file(1) identifies all eight MP4s as ISO Media MP4 files.

scene_off_flashlight_off is truly dark in the saved artifacts. Metadata and independent frame analysis both report frame_count=240, mean_luma_min=0.0, mean_luma_median=0.0, mean_luma_max=0.0, p99_luma_median=0.0, and bright_pixel_fraction_median gte_200=0.0/gte_230=0.0. render_diagnostics also marks no_flashlight_ever_control=true, spawn_flashlight=false, flashlight_ever_spawned_after_setting_setup=false, and flashlight_ever_enabled_after_setting_setup=false.

scene_off_flashlight_on now behaves as a flashlight-only contribution over a black scene-off baseline. Independent luma is mean min/median/max 18.139/19.637/21.021 with p99 median 229.255 and bright-pixel median gte_200=4.19%. The off-to-on delta median is +19.637 mean luma because the off baseline is zero; visual inspection shows a localized circular flashlight pool and black surrounding frame rather than scene-wide ambient lighting.

The scene-on settings remain lit. scene_on_flashlight_off has independent mean luma min/median/max 92.731/132.190/148.200 and scene_on_flashlight_on has 97.012/133.475/148.274, matching the metadata and luma summary. Visual inspection confirms the cafeteria remains globally illuminated in both scene-on conditions.

No progressive exposure or brightness accumulation is evident in saved RGB outputs. scene_off_flashlight_off remains 0.0 for every frame. scene_off_flashlight_on starts at 20.973917 and ends at 20.973989, with 117 increasing and 122 decreasing frame steps; 24-frame chunk means stay bounded between 18.398 and 20.770. Scene-on first/last luma is also stable to about 0.002 luma units despite orbit-dependent view changes.

Depth diagnostics are coherent across lighting settings. Comparing all 240 depth_meters_npy frames yielded max_abs_depth_diff=0.0 and mismatched_frames=0 for scene_off on/off, scene_on on/off, and scene_off_flashlight_off versus scene_on_flashlight_off.

Residual risk remains in metadata, but it does not invalidate this artifact run: render_history_disable_verified=false for rgb and depth_meters in all settings, and scene-off capture_show_flags_configured=false even though engine_ini_applied=true. dark_map_report.json also reports force_no_precomputed_lighting_set=true but map_build_data_cleared=false. The empirical saved-frame evidence is clean, but these unverified controls should remain tracked if future maps reintroduce residual brightness.

orbit_render_validation.log includes engine_service.py ERROR: Unexpected frame state: request_begin_next_frame near shutdown for each split render pass, but both passes reached run_orbit_collection.py:2417 Done and wrote the expected outputs and diagnostics. This appears to be shutdown noise rather than an artifact failure.

follow_up_recommendations: Approve this validation run as resolving the prior dark-map residual scene-off brightness/flicker issue for the saved orbit outputs.
Keep the unverified render-history/show-flag metadata as a known robustness risk for Builder/Scout only if the issue reappears on another map; no immediate rerender is recommended.
memory_worthy: Dark cafeteria validation at examples/flashlight/orbit_collection_output_validation_dark_map passed on 2026-07-01: scene_off_flashlight_off is black for all 240 frames with median mean luma 0.0, scene_off_flashlight_on is localized flashlight-only with median mean luma 19.637, scene-on settings remain lit, and no saved-frame progressive exposure accumulation is evident.
